findings.current: He also knew that, however angry I was, I couldn’t kill him here.
findings.defect: “Here” makes the limitation location-based. The Korean says Michael knew I could not kill him immediately.
findings.rationale: The source phrase 당장 ... 죽이지 못하리라는 means “couldn’t kill him right away”; it does not specify that the aircraft or current location is the constraint.
findings.replacement: He also knew that, however angry I was, I couldn’t kill him right away.

summary: The assembled chapter is faithful overall; one minor temporal detail shifts in the narration.
